cases.scenario: New users complete their role tasks after the stated training time
cases.role: Member, Organizer, Secretary, Chair, Admin, Guest
cases.given: Users who have not used TrustCabinet; a 30-minute introduction for Members and 2 hours for the officer roles
cases.when: Each user, unaided after the training, performs the tasks listed in Report 3 for their role
cases.then: Every user completes their tasks without help
cases.note: Skip in Round 1: needs real users timed through guided sessions; planned for the acceptance test (Report 5.5). · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514

cases.scenario: Screens are in Vietnamese and search ignores diacritics
cases.given: A member signed in; meetings titled "[SYS] Họp giao ban …"
cases.when: Open Lịch làm việc, Cuộc họp, Kho tài liệu, Giọng nói của tôi, Báo cáo and look for English UI words; search the meeting list for "hop giao ban" without diacritics
cases.then: No English UI word appears; the search finds the "Họp giao ban" meetings
cases.note: Measured: no English UI word on the 5 screens; "hop giao ban" found 6 "Họp giao ban" rows. Emails and notifications in Vietnamese: SYS_WF07, SYS_WF09. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: The same status badge, date format and shell on every screen
cases.when: Open it in the list and in its detail; open three screens and look for the sidebar and the bell
cases.then: The status reads "Đã kết thúc" in both places; dates are dd/mm/yyyy; every screen has the same navigation and bell
cases.note: Measured: "Đã kết thúc" in list and detail; date 23/11/2026; sidebar and bell on all 3 screens. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: No sideways scrolling at 1024 px and at 360 px on the member screens
cases.given: A published meeting with documents and votes
cases.when: Open the meeting list, the meeting, its Biểu quyết and Tài liệu tabs and the calendar at 1024 px and at 360 px
cases.then: No page scrolls sideways at either width
cases.note: Measured: overflow 0 px on all 10 page × width combinations. Invitation answer at 390 px: SYS_WF02_TC08. Guest verification screen at 360 px not checked (needs a guest session). · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: The app works in Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge on Windows
cases.given: The latest stable Chrome and Edge
cases.when: Sign in, open the meeting list and the calendar in each
cases.note: Measured: Chrome 158.0.8127.36 and Edge 158.0.4370.33, list and calendar work, no script errors. Firefox, Safari and mobile browsers are TC-USA-010. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-185048 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: Labelled fields, keyboard-only sign-in and a usable page at 200% zoom
cases.given: The sign-in page and the meeting list
cases.when: Check every field has a label; sign in with the keyboard only; open the meeting list in a 720 px viewport (200% of 1440 px)
cases.then: No unlabelled field; Tab reaches email, password, show-password, sign-in and Google; Enter signs in; no sideways scrolling at 200%
cases.note: Measured: 0 unlabelled fields; Tab order email → "Hiện mật khẩu" → "Đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu" → Google; signed in by keyboard; 0 px overflow at 200%. Contrast ratio not measured. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: A validation error sits by the field, keeps what was typed and shows no code or trace
cases.when: Type a place, leave the title empty and click "Tạo cuộc họp"
cases.then: "Tên cuộc họp không được để trống." under the title, marked invalid; the place is kept; no MSG code or stack trace on screen
cases.note: Measured as expected. Server messages in Vietnamese by code: SYS_WF01_TC03, TC07, TC09. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.requirement: Confirmation of destructive and irreversible actions
cases.scenario: Cancelling a meeting and deleting an agenda item ask first and name the object
cases.given: A published meeting with an agenda item "Mục sẽ xoá"
cases.when: Click "Huỷ cuộc họp" then "Giữ cuộc họp"; as the Secretary click delete on the item
cases.then: The cancel dialog names the meeting, says invitees are told and "Không hoàn tác được."; keeping changes nothing; the delete dialog names the item
cases.note: Measured: cancel dialog names the meeting with "Không hoàn tác được."; status stays Published; delete dialog "Xoá nội dung “Mục sẽ xoá”?". Other confirmations seen in WF-01 (deactivate), WF-03 (close vote, end meeting), WF-04 (issue minutes), WF-06 (withdraw consent). · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: Uploads show progress and a form cannot be sent twice
cases.given: A slow upload (delayed 3 s) and a slow meeting creation (delayed 2.5 s)
cases.when: Upload a PDF to the meeting; click "Tạo cuộc họp" and click again while it saves
cases.then: The tray shows "Đang tải lên" with progress; the create button is disabled while saving and only one request is sent
cases.note: Measured: tray "Đang tải lên 0/1 tệp … 0%"; create button disabled, 1 POST sent. Transcription status shown in tab "Bản ghi" (TC-REL-003). · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: The app works in Firefox, Safari (desktop) and on Chrome for Android and Safari on iOS
cases.given: The two latest stable versions of each browser
cases.when: Sign in, open the meeting list, the calendar, a document and the online room
cases.then: Everything works; where WebRTC or permissions are missing the room says what is missing
cases.note: Skip in Round 1: only Chromium-based browsers are installed on the Windows test machine.
